newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Jan-July trade surplus widens to $1.4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Jan-July trade surplus widens to $1.4 bln.

text.p: Kazakhstan posted a trade surplus of $1.401 billion in the first seven months of this year after a $587.7 million surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
KAZAKH MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Jul 96 Jan-Jun 96 Jan-Jul 95

Notes -- Figures in million dollars, FOB. The Statistics Committee said 62 percent of trade turnover was conducted with former Soviet states, 23 percent with European countries and 13 percent with Asian states.
